title: Laxman Utekar, Rajkumar Periasamy and Vishnuvardhan Set New Films With Bhushan Kumar’s T-Series (EXCLUSIVE)
content:
ByNaman Ramachandran

Directors Laxman Utekar, Rajkumar Periasamy and Vishnuvardhan are set to collaborate with Indian studioT-Serieschair and managing directorBhushan Kumaron three new films.

Title, story, cast and production details have not been disclosed yet.

Utekar directed the 2025 hit Hindi-language historical drama “Chhaava.” Periasamy won the best director prize at India’s National Film Awards for Tamil-language military biopic “Amaran,” while Vishnuvardhan’s Hindi-language war film “Shershaah” took the event’s Special Jury Award.

The three collaborations add to a busy T-Series pipeline that runs across Bollywood and South Indian cinema, with leading stars from both industries attached. Several of those titles are produced by T-Series, while others are presented by the company.

Under its own production banner, T-Series is backing Sandeep Reddy Vanga’s “Spirit,” which stars Prabhas, and an untitled Anurag Basu film with Kartik Aaryan. Also on the roster are Ram Gopal Varma’s “Police Company” and an untitled Milap Zaveri project pairing Aditya Roy Kapur and Tara Sutaria.

Kumar is producing “The Pride of Bharat – Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj,” a historical drama in two parts from director Sandeep Singh, with “Kantara” starRishab Shettyin the lead. Aaryan has a second film on the slate, Shimit Amin’s “Captain India.” “Khosla Ka Ghosla 2,” “Karnika” and “Jaani Dushman” round out the list.

In the south, T-Series is presenting Hanu Raghavapudi’s “Fauzi,” which gives Prabhas a second title on the slate, and Prasanth Varma’s mythological feature “Jai Hanuman.” The company is also presenting Prashanth Neel’s “Dragon,” led by Jr NTR, and Sukumar’s next film with Ram Charan, which reunites director and star.

In all, the slate takes in action, romance, period drama and mythology, and spans both the Bollywood and South Indian industries.
title_zh: 拉克斯曼·烏特卡爾(Laxman Utekar)、拉傑庫馬爾·佩里亞薩米(Rajkumar Periasamy) 和維什努瓦爾丹(Vishnuvardhan) 與布尚·庫馬爾(Bhushan Kumar) 的 T-Series 開啟新片計畫 (獨家)
content_zh:
由納曼·拉馬昌德蘭(Naman Ramachandran)報導

導演拉克斯曼·烏特卡爾(Laxman Utekar)、拉吉庫馬爾·佩里亞薩米(Rajkumar Periasamy)和維什努瓦爐丹(Vishnuvardhan)將與印度工作室T-Series的主席兼董事總經理布尚·庫馬爾(Bhushan Kumar)合作製作三部新片。

目前尚未透露標題、故事、演員和製作細節。

烏特卡爾執導的2025年熱門印地語歷史劇《查哈瓦》(Chhaava)獲得好評。佩里亞薩米因其泰米爾語軍事傳記片《阿馬蘭》(Amaran)在印度國家電影獎中獲得最佳導演獎，而維什努瓦爐丹的印地語戰爭片《謝爾沙》(Shershaah)則獲得該活動的特別評審獎。

這三部合作作品為T-Series繁忙的製作計劃增添了新內容，該計劃涵蓋了寶萊塢和南印度電影，並有來自兩個行業的頂尖明星參與。其中幾部作品由T-Series製作，其他則由該公司呈現。

在其自有製作品牌下，T-Series正在支持桑迪普·雷迪·萬加(Sandeep Reddy Vanga)的《精神》(Spirit)，該片由普拉巴斯(Prabhas)主演，以及一部未命名的阿努拉格·巴蘇(Anurag Basu)電影，主演為卡爾提克·阿亞倫(Kartik Aaryan)。名單上還包括拉姆·戈帕爾·瓦爾馬(Ram Gopal Varma)的《警察公司》(Police Company)和一部未命名的米拉普·扎維里(Milap Zaveri)項目，主演為阿迪提亞·羅伊·卡普爾(Aditya Roy Kapur)和塔拉·蘇塔里亞(Tara Sutaria)。

庫馬爾正在製作《印度之榮—查特拉帕蒂·希瓦吉·馬哈拉吉》(The Pride of Bharat – Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj)，這是一部由桑迪普·辛格(Sandeep Singh)執導的兩部分歷史劇，主角為《坎塔拉》(Kantara)明星瑞沙布·謝提(Rishab Shetty)。阿亞倫還有第二部電影在籌備中，即希米特·阿敏(Shimit Amin)的《印度隊長》(Captain India)。名單上還包括《科斯拉的科斯拉2》(Khosla Ka Ghosla 2)、《卡爾尼卡》(Karnika)和《詹尼·杜什曼》(Jaani Dushman)。

在南方，T-Series正在呈現哈努·拉哈瓦普迪(Hanu Raghavapudi)的《福茲》(Fauzi)，這為普拉巴斯帶來了第二部作品，還有普拉桑特·瓦爾瑪(Prasanth Varma)的神話電影《哈奴曼之歌》(Jai Hanuman)。該公司還在呈現普拉尚特·尼爾(Prashanth Neel)的《龍》(Dragon)，由小NTR(Jr NTR)主演，以及蘇庫馬(Sukumar)與拉姆·查蘭(Ram Charan)的下一部電影，這對導演和明星再次合作。

總的來說，這些作品涵蓋了動作、浪漫、時代劇和神話，並跨越了寶萊塢和南印度電影產業。
